messages.subject: Cannot open the conexion. Warning message: In file(file, ifelse(append, "a", "w"))  cannot open..
parts:
Hi everyone!

I'm working with temporaly wordking directories (in a Rstudio server) as follows:

wd   <- tempdir()
setwd( wd )
res.path <- paste0( wd, "/OUT/" )
dir.create( res.path )

To this point, it's everything ok. However, when I want to create a function in order to save the results in a .txt file, I use next code:

 write( paste( "SAIC50. ", a, ", ", date(), sep = "" ), file = paste( res.path, myfile, sep = "" ) )
 write( "----------------------------------", file = paste (res.path, myfile, sep = ""), append = TRUE )
 write( paste( "IC50 = ", l[[3]], sep = "" ), file = paste( res.path, myfile, sep = "" ), append = TRUE )


* myfile <- "Resultado-ajuste5-ic50-2017-07-03.txt"
* res.path <-  "/tmp/RtmpVygfad/OUT/"

I find the following error: 

Error in file: cannot open the conexion
Warning message:
In file(file, ifelse(append, "a", "w")) :
  cannot open file '/tmp/RtmpVygfad/OUT/Resultado-ajuste5-ic50-2017-07-10.txt':  No such file or directory

Thanks for your help!
